description: October 30 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 30 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the first decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: Personality of an October 30 birthday
paragraphs: Scorpio is not always associated with banter, which makes the 30th of October an intriguing mix. Six degrees into the sign, in the Pluto decan, the emotional depth is unmistakable, but thirty reduces to 3, the number of expression and humour. The result is often read as dark wit: sharp, observant storytelling that reveals more truth than it first appears to.

By noon UTC on October 30, the Sun has normally reached roughly 6° of Scorpio. That places the date in the Scorpio decan that astrologers give to Pluto, the first of three. Pluto rules Scorpio in modern astrology and also governs its first decan, so late October and the first days of November hold the sign in concentrated form. This decan is traditionally associated with intensity, privacy and a capacity to go deep into whatever it touches, whether a relationship, a mystery or a personal reinvention. Trust tends to be slow and, once given, complete. Doubled Pluto can bring a strong will and a reluctance to show vulnerability. Natives often find their power in honest transformation: releasing what no longer fits rather than guarding it out of habit.

sections.heading: Numerology of the October 30 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same October 30 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: October 30 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 30 is the 303rd day of the year (304th in a leap year). In most years Sagittarius season is under way by November 23, 24 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 30 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. October 30 is also the birthday of John Adams (1735), Diego Maradona (1960) and Ezra Pound (1885).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 30?
faq.answer: October 30 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 30 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 30?
faq.answer: By October 30 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 30?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an October 30 birthday are John Adams (1735), Diego Maradona (1960) and Ezra Pound (1885). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
